description: This file defines the class ValidationResult, which represents the outcome of validation checks related to migration requirements in the SuiteCRM project. It encapsulates issues found during validation and provides methods to assess validity and generate string descriptions of the validation status.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the validation state including issues found during system validation, and provides methods to check validity, report issues, and convert the validation result to a string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ValidationResult instance with an optional array of issues.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the validation result, indicating whether validation passed or failed, and listing issues if any.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if there are no issues, indicating validation passed; otherwise, false.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Returns the array of issues identified during validation.
